assign.outcome:
**Two pages you can look at: where two grounds meet, and the repeated colored anchor.**

### [Where two grounds meet](/imagine/design/color/sections/)

61 specimens, every number read off the rendered pixels. Every ordered pairing of the site's six grounds — white, light gray, mid gray, dark gray, black, and the accent — stacked with the seam running the full width, then every one of them nested, plus one control the six cannot show. Drag the hue and the accent band follows, including which ink it has to take.

> **Every one of these 30 seams is visible: the quietest — mid gray against accent, 7.3 ΔL\* apart — is still wider than the smallest step this theme makes on purpose, a card off the page floor at 4.5 ΔL\*. The 16 that flip the ink from dark to light read as two pages; the other 14 read as two sections of one page. Nested, 1 of these 31 cards is closer to its section than that step, so its padding buys nothing you can see** — and that one is the theme's own card, which is held up by a shadow instead.

/framework/ai/2026-09-17/type-color-study/shots/sections-1280.jpg

### [The repeated anchor](/imagine/design/type/anchors/)

One post, three times, word for word identical — only the little mark after each h2 changes: the accent, a grey, or an accent underline. `anchors.css` declares no `font-size` at all; the mark and the eyebrow are the h4 level.

> **A reads as anchored and B does not, even though B's grey mark has the HIGHER contrast — 5.4:1 against 5.2:1. B is the same grey family as the body ink, so it reads as part of the paragraph; A's orange is the only colour on the post, so the eye finds all three marks before it reads a word.** Contrast decides whether a thing can be read; difference decides whether it is found.

/framework/ai/2026-09-17/type-color-study/shots/anchors-1280.jpg

### Also

- The record for each: [color/sections/decisions.md](/imagine/design/color/sections/decisions.md) · [type/anchors/decisions.md](/imagine/design/type/anchors/decisions.md)
- Both linked from their parents ([Color](/imagine/design/color/), [Type](/imagine/design/type/)) by a `children:` word and a visible line; the anchors page is linked from the layout skill's *Color meets color* section.
- Shots at 1280 and 3440 in `shots/`. Four pages load clean at 1600 with every fold open: zero console errors, zero failed requests, nothing at x:0 at 400 / 1280 / 3440.

### Two bugs the build found

- A bare `muted` modifier class on a post picked up framework.css's own `.muted` utility and faded the **entire** post — heading, body and all — looking like a deliberate design. Prefixed.
- `auto-fit` counts its repetitions using the track's **max** when that max is definite, so `minmax(min(20rem,100%), 34em)` fitted only two of three posts at 1280. The ceiling belongs on the wall, not the track.

### Left

- The layout skill's colour bullet still says *(the study grows a sections page for this)*; the sections page now exists, but the fence allowed one link in that section and it went to the anchors page. One line for whoever owns the skill.
- `styles/css-scopes.txt` is outside the fence, so the new `type-` namespace is reserved in [anchors/decisions.md](/imagine/design/type/anchors/decisions.md) under Open, with the literal line to paste.
- The accent's lightness is pinned at 69% by the parent study's sliders, so no drag can make a seam disappear. A lightness slider belongs on that study's `lab()`, which is out of fence.
